_comment: Network branding lookup — separate from registry.json on purpose: this is presentation metadata (name synonyms + logo), not part of the token-registry schema. Logos sourced from the Trust Wallet assets repo (already on our icon domain allowlist, src/icon/domain-allowlist.ts) rather than a generic multi-hundred-chain dataset (e.g. ethereum-lists/chains), since we only need the handful of networks this registry actually lists — every URL below was checked to return 200.
